budget_overspend.why_template: Exceeding your planned category cap directly drains your month-end free cash flow and reduces what you can put toward your savings goals.
budget_overspend.how_template: Calculated by comparing actual posted expenses ({actual_amount}) against your set budget threshold ({budget_amount}). Pacing variance: +{overspend_amount}.
budget_overspend.next_action_template: Cap {category_name} spending for the remainder of this month or move budget from an underused category.

budget_projected_overspend.why_template: Your current daily spending velocity in {category_name} will breach your monthly cap before the month ends if left unchecked.
budget_projected_overspend.how_template: Projected from your average daily spend ({actual_amount} across {days_elapsed} days) scaled to {days_in_month} days = {projected_amount} vs budget {budget_amount}.
budget_projected_overspend.next_action_template: Set a weekly guardrail of {weekly_guardrail} for the next 2 weeks to stay within plan.

budget_exhausted_early.why_template: Consuming {pct_used}% of your budget before mid-month leaves little flexibility for unexpected expenses in the second half of the month.
budget_exhausted_early.how_template: {actual_amount} spent out of {budget_amount} by day {day_of_month} of {days_in_month}.
budget_exhausted_early.next_action_template: Temporarily pause discretionary purchases in {category_name} until the next billing cycle.

budget_surplus.why_template: Unused budget headroom in one category can be redirected to cover overspent categories or accelerate a goal.
budget_surplus.how_template: Only {pct_used}% of your {category_name} budget used so far, leaving {surplus_amount} unspent with {days_left} days remaining.
budget_surplus.next_action_template: Move {surplus_amount} from {category_name} into your savings goals or emergency buffer.

trend_surge_mom.why_template: A steep month-over-month increase often signals recurring scope creep or untracked one-off splurges.
trend_surge_mom.how_template: Compared current month expenses ({current_amount}) with prior month ({prior_amount}), yielding a +{pct_increase}% increase (+{increase_amount}).
trend_surge_mom.next_action_template: Review recent transactions in {category_name} to confirm if the increase is intentional or can be trimmed.

trend_surge_90d.why_template: Consistently spending above your 90-day baseline indicates lifestyle creep or a category that needs a realistic budget cap.
trend_surge_90d.how_template: Projected monthly pace ({projected_amount}) is {pct_above_baseline}% above your 3-month rolling baseline ({baseline_90d}).
trend_surge_90d.next_action_template: Calibrate your budget cap for {category_name} to align with your real spending baseline.

trend_category_drift.why_template: Category drift shifts your overall spending mix without conscious budgeting decisions, crowding out priority goals.
trend_category_drift.how_template: {category_name} represents {current_share_pct}% of total spending this month versus {baseline_share_pct}% historically.
trend_category_drift.next_action_template: Rebalance your spending allocation to keep {category_name} within your desired proportion.

recurring_price_increase.why_template: Recurring cost increases accumulate silently over time, permanently eroding monthly savings without added utility.
recurring_price_increase.how_template: Detected {increase_pct}% increase from prior charge of {previous_amount} to new charge of {current_amount} (+{increase_amount}/cycle).
recurring_price_increase.next_action_template: Review this service: negotiate a lower tier, look for promotional rates, or cancel if unneeded.

recurring_missed_payment.why_template: Missed bill payments can incur late penalties, interest charges, or impact service continuity and credit health.
recurring_missed_payment.how_template: Scheduled payment of {amount} was due on {due_date} ({days_overdue} days ago) with no matching debit transaction posted.
recurring_missed_payment.next_action_template: Verify whether this bill was paid manually or needs immediate settlement.

recurring_bill_cluster.why_template: A heavy debit cluster in a short window creates overdraft risk if liquid cash does not comfortably cover the outflow.
recurring_bill_cluster.how_template: {bill_count} upcoming scheduled debits totaling {total_bills_amount} represent {drain_ratio_pct}% of liquid balance ({liquid_balance}).
recurring_bill_cluster.next_action_template: Ensure at least {total_bills_amount} is available in your debit account, or delay non-essential purchases.

recurring_subscription_audit.why_template: Multiple concurrent subscriptions often contain underutilized services that quietly bleed money each month.
recurring_subscription_audit.how_template: {subscription_count} active recurring subscriptions identified, consuming a total of {total_monthly_cost} per month.
recurring_subscription_audit.next_action_template: Cancel at least 1 underutilized subscription to save an estimated 10-20% on monthly fixed overhead.

cashflow_shortfall.why_template: Projected negative cash flow causes bounced debits, overdraft fees, and forced liquidations.
cashflow_shortfall.how_template: Actual balance forecast: Starting cash {current_liquid_balance} minus scheduled recurring bills and baseline burn dips negative by {shortfall_amount} on {shortfall_date}.
cashflow_shortfall.next_action_template: Transfer at least {shortfall_amount} into your primary account before {shortfall_date} to prevent overdraft.

cashflow_safety_buffer_breached.why_template: Breaching your safety threshold leaves you vulnerable to unexpected emergencies before your next income cycle.
cashflow_safety_buffer_breached.how_template: Projected lowest balance is {min_projected_balance}, falling {buffer_deficit} short of your {safety_buffer} emergency buffer.
cashflow_safety_buffer_breached.next_action_template: Postpone non-essential shopping or dining until after your next paycheck.

cashflow_low_balance_before_income.why_template: Running on a razor-thin balance before payday forces reliance on credit cards or high-interest short-term debt.
cashflow_low_balance_before_income.how_template: Projected cash drops to {min_balance_before_income} over the {days_to_income} days leading up to your next income on {next_income_date}.
cashflow_low_balance_before_income.next_action_template: Limit spending strictly to essentials until your deposit of {next_income_amount} clears.

savings_rate_decline.why_template: A dropping savings rate slows down wealth accumulation and delays your long-term financial independence milestones.
savings_rate_decline.how_template: Current savings rate is {current_savings_rate}%, down from {prior_savings_rate}% last month (-{rate_drop_pct}%).
savings_rate_decline.next_action_template: Reduce discretionary expenses by {recovery_amount} over the next 2 weeks to restore your target savings pace.

savings_rate_surplus.why_template: Capturing spending windfalls immediately locks in savings before surplus cash is absorbed by lifestyle inflation.
savings_rate_surplus.how_template: Savings rate rose by +{improvement_pct}% to reach {current_savings_rate}%, creating an extra {surplus_amount} in free cash.
savings_rate_surplus.next_action_template: Deposit {surplus_amount} into your highest-priority savings goal or emergency fund.

goal_overdue.why_template: Overdue goals create planning debt; resetting realistic timelines keeps your financial strategy actionable and motivating.
goal_overdue.how_template: Target date {target_date} passed {days_overdue} days ago. Progress: {current_amount} of {target_amount} ({shortfall_amount} remaining).
goal_overdue.next_action_template: Extend target date by 3 to 6 months, or adjust target amount to match current feasibility.

goal_behind_schedule.why_template: Falling behind on savings goals compounds over time, making future target dates harder to achieve without drastic cuts.
goal_behind_schedule.how_template: To reach {target_amount} by {target_date} from current balance {current_amount}, required monthly pace is {monthly_needed}.
goal_behind_schedule.next_action_template: Increase monthly contribution for this goal to {monthly_needed} by reallocating from low-priority spending.

merchant_concentration_high.why_template: Heavy merchant concentration often points to an unconscious spending routine or convenience premium that can be optimized.
merchant_concentration_high.how_template: {merchant_name} captured {concentration_pct}% ({merchant_spend}) of all discretionary spending across {transaction_count} orders.
merchant_concentration_high.next_action_template: Set a monthly cap on {merchant_name} or explore lower-cost alternatives.

behavior_weekend_spike.why_template: Concentrated weekend spending surges can undo an entire week of disciplined budgeting in just two days.
behavior_weekend_spike.how_template: Weekend purchases totaled {weekend_spend} ({weekend_tx_count} orders), accounting for {weekend_pct}% of monthly discretionary spend.
behavior_weekend_spike.next_action_template: Set a dedicated weekly weekend allowance of {weekend_budget} to keep recreation spending intentional.

behavior_delivery_spike.why_template: Frequent app delivery incurs service fees, delivery tips, and menu markups that inflate food costs by 30-50%.
behavior_delivery_spike.next_action_template: Cap delivery orders to 1-2 times per week or meal-prep convenience staples.

behavior_payday_splurge.why_template: Splurging immediately after getting paid drains liquidity early, causing artificial end-of-month cash pinches.
behavior_payday_splurge.how_template: {splurge_pct}% of your {income_amount} deposit was spent within 72 hours on non-essential purchases.
behavior_payday_splurge.next_action_template: Set up an automatic goal transfer on payday so your savings are safeguarded before discretionary spending starts.

statistical_spending_anomaly.why_template: Outlier transactions warrant verification to rule out billing errors, duplicate charges, or unbudgeted impulse buys.
statistical_spending_anomaly.how_template: Transaction of {transaction_amount} is {z_score} standard deviations above your 90-day average transaction size of {mean_amount}.
statistical_spending_anomaly.next_action_template: Confirm this charge: check receipt, verify no recurring subscription was billed incorrectly, and add notes.
